questions.question: At Jesus' trial, Pilate offered to free a prisoner at Passover. Which man did the Jews shout for instead of Jesus?
When Jesus stood before Pilate, what reason did the Jews give for saying He must die by their law?

answers.text: He declared Himself the Son of God
He healed people on the Sabbath

questions.question: At Jesus' trial, Pilate asked if he should crucify the Jews' King. What did the chief priests answer?

answers.text: We have no king but Caesar
Our only King is the Lord

questions.question: After the crowd demanded that Jesus be crucified, Pilate set Jesus free. True or false?
